steps.name: Quick start in 7 steps
steps.description: Open a web page, click the Manuscript icon, hit New Manuscript, and start authoring—pick elements, layer annotations, replay with keyboard shortcuts.

annotations.text: Open a web page, click the Manuscript icon, hit New Manuscript, and start authoring—pick elements, layer annotations, replay with keyboard shortcuts.

steps.name: Picking elements with 3-layer fallback
steps.description: Manuscript records three ways to find each element—internal names, visible text with position, and screen location. The page changes? It tries each clue until one lands on the right spot.

annotations.text: Manuscript records three ways to find each element—internal names, visible text with position, and screen location. The page changes? It tries each clue until one lands on the right spot.

steps.name: Text, shapes, freedraw, and effects
steps.description: Layer annotations with color, font, effect, and opacity. Click any annotation to open its property popup. Resize, rotate, or delete with handles. Undo, copy formatting, and paste copies—all built in.

annotations.text: Layer annotations with color, font, effect, and opacity. Click any annotation to open its property popup. Resize, rotate, or delete with handles. Undo, copy formatting, and paste copies—all built in.

steps.name: Steps, reorder, title, description, timer
steps.description: Insert between cards, append at the bottom, drag to reorder. Edit title and description inline. Set auto-advance time with the timer. Toggle between auto-advance and wait-for-click.

annotations.text: Insert between cards, append at the bottom, drag to reorder. Edit title and description inline. Set auto-advance time with the timer. Toggle between auto-advance and wait-for-click.

steps.name: Inner flow—sequence elements with smooth transitions
steps.description: Add sub-elements to spotlight a row of related items in sequence. The step's total time splits evenly across primary and subs. Drag gaps to rebalance time. Use time-shift chevrons to nudge subs earlier or later.

annotations.text: Add sub-elements to spotlight a row of related items in sequence. The step's total time splits evenly across primary and subs. Drag gaps to rebalance time. Use time-shift chevrons to nudge subs earlier or later.

steps.name: Action steps—wait for user click
steps.description: Click the pause icon to turn a step into an action. During replay, a bubble appears on the target and auto-advance pauses. When the user clicks, Manuscript resumes on the new page if navigation happens.

annotations.text: Click the pause icon to turn a step into an action. During replay, a bubble appears on the target and auto-advance pauses. When the user clicks, Manuscript resumes on the new page if navigation happens.

steps.name: Replay with control bar, keyboard, prompter, voice
steps.description: Hit the play button to start. Use arrow keys and space to navigate. Open the detached prompter window for a three-column view. Enable voice narration. Match full URL for query/hash-routed sites.

annotations.text: Hit the play button to start. Use arrow keys and space to navigate. Open the detached prompter window for a three-column view. Enable voice narration. Match full URL for query/hash-routed sites.

steps.name: Record tours to video—multi-page in one take
steps.description: Click the red record button to start a separate recorder window. It plays the tour automatically, captures voice narration and page sounds, and follows page navigation. Pause anytime to add your voice.

annotations.text: Click the red record button to start a separate recorder window. It plays the tour automatically, captures voice narration and page sounds, and follows page navigation. Pause anytime to add your voice.

steps.name: Validate steps against page changes
steps.description: Check if your steps still match the page. Green means perfect, yellow means recovered another way, red means not found. Navigate multi-page tours automatically. Re-pick individual steps or subs.

annotations.text: Check if your steps still match the page. Green means perfect, yellow means recovered another way, red means not found. Navigate multi-page tours automatically. Re-pick individual steps or subs.

steps.name: Export as JSON, import from popup
steps.description: Download your entire manuscript as a JSON file with all steps, annotations, colors, and fonts. Import from the popup with one click. Older files upgrade automatically to the current version.

annotations.text: Download your entire manuscript as a JSON file with all steps, annotations, colors, and fonts. Import from the popup with one click. Older files upgrade automatically to the current version.

steps.name: Resume recent manuscripts from popup
steps.description: Click the extension icon a second time to see your Previous Manuscripts list. The most recent is marked Resume—one click restores your work on the same page where you left off.

annotations.text: Click the extension icon a second time to see your Previous Manuscripts list. The most recent is marked Resume—one click restores your work on the same page where you left off.
